PREREQUISITE_CANCELLED.message: A prerequisite was cancelled; cancellation does not satisfy a dependency.

INCONSISTENT_COMPLETION.message: The dependent task is completed while a prerequisite is still open.

PREREQUISITE_DUE_AFTER_DEPENDENT.message: The prerequisite is due after the task that depends on it.

REDUNDANT_TRANSITIVE.message: This edge is already implied by a longer chain of prerequisites.

e5.note: Optional consistency-aware edge selection. Constraint handling only, evaluated on synthetic graphs; no semantic accuracy claim.
